add_text_prompt: Enter kaomoji or any text content:
already_running_msg:
GIFManager is already running.
Please do not open it again; this launch will exit automatically.
auto_input_enable: Click an emoji to type it into the focused input
auto_input_hint: When enabled, click the chat input first (WeChat/QQ), then click an emoji — it is typed in directly (no manual paste).
card_size_hint: Card display size. Ctrl+wheel also adjusts it.
clipboard_copy_failed: Copy failed: the file is missing
confirm_delete_group_msg: Delete group "{name}" and all its stickers?
create_group_failed_msg: The group name already exists. Please try another name.
default_group_missing: The default group does not exist!
delete_copies_prompt: This sticker exists in {count} groups. Select the groups to delete:
drag_placeholder: Drop GIF files here or click "Import GIF"
empty_image_group: This group has no stickers yet
ffmpeg_hint: FFmpeg is used for dimension probing and image/GIF conversion. Leave the path empty to auto-detect the bundled FFmpeg.
ffmpeg_path_hint: Leave empty to use the bundled ffmpeg when present.
gif_auto_convert: Auto-convert images to GIF on import
gif_auto_convert_hint: When enabled, imported png/jpg/webp images are converted to GIF so they send as animated stickers.
gif_convert_all: Convert All Images to GIF Now
gif_convert_confirm:
All non-GIF images in every group will be converted to GIF; originals are deleted on success.
Continue?
gif_convert_done:
Conversion done:
{converted} converted, {failed} failed, {deduped} duplicates merged.
gif_convert_none: Nothing to convert (all stickers are already GIF).
gif_ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg not found (put ffmpeg.exe into the ffmpeg folder next to the program).
gif_render_hint: Rendering more animated GIFs at once is smoother but uses more CPU; too many can make scrolling stutter.
global_sort_hint:
When enabled, emojis in every group are re-arranged automatically by the chosen rule and direction.
Your manual drag-and-drop order will be overwritten whenever emojis are added or used.
Keep this OFF if you want to preserve your own arrangement.
gpu_accel_hint: The interface is always composited on the GPU by Qt (measured as Direct3D 11 on this machine); this switch does not change that, so toggling it has no visible effect. To choose which adapter is used, set "Preferred GPU" below.
gpu_pref_hint: When on: thumbnails are rendered in parallel (all CPU cores) for speed, and Windows is asked to use the chosen GPU for this program (Settings → Display → Graphics; takes effect on the next launch). When off, that request is cleared and rendering is serial.
gpu_pref_target: Written for this program: {exe} (currently recorded: {state}; takes effect on the next launch)
gpu_usage_active: This program is using a GPU (LUID: {luids})
gpu_usage_none: This program's GPU usage: none. Qt paints widgets with the CPU raster engine, so the interface itself never runs on the GPU — this switch only parallelises thumbnail decoding and asks Windows for the chosen adapter. To get interface painting onto the GPU, tick the experimental GPU viewport below and restart.
gpu_usage_unknown: This program's GPU usage: press "Detect GPUs" to check
gpu_viewport_enable: Experimental: render the interface on the GPU (needs a restart)
gpu_viewport_hint: When on, the sticker grid is composited through an OpenGL surface, so this process really uses the chosen GPU (you can see the activity in Task Manager). It needs a restart and is deliberately never switched at runtime — doing that used to crash the renderer. If the system has no usable OpenGL, it falls back to the CPU viewport.
group_builtin_locked: A built-in group cannot be renamed or deleted.
group_delete_confirm: Delete the group "{name}" and its {count} sticker(s)? This cannot be undone.
group_delete_failed: The group could not be deleted.
group_dir_locked: The folder could not be renamed; a file may be in use.
group_name_taken: That name is already in use.
group_name_unusable: That name cannot be used (the folder is taken or the name has invalid characters).
hotkey_capture_hint: Click here, then press the shortcut...
hotkey_fail: Hotkey registration failed (possibly in use by another program)
hotkey_hint: Click the input box below, press a key combination or a mouse side button. ESC clears, click empty area to save
hotkey_register_failed: Global hotkey {sequence} could not be registered: {reason}
import_conv_fail: ({count} failed to convert, kept original format)
import_explain: Choose image files, or choose a folder to import every importable image inside it.
import_needs_image_group: Choose or create an image group first.
import_not_wired: Import is not wired to a file picker yet.\nThe pipeline is available as store.import_emojis_batch().
import_nothing_new: There was nothing new to import.
import_qq_none: No QQ emoji found (make sure QQ is logged in and personal stickers were saved)
move_failed: Move failed: the file may be in use.
name: English

no_image_to_preview: This group has no image stickers to preview.

perf_hint: Number of CPU cores allowed for multi-threaded tasks (thumbnail rendering, batch import). More cores speed up background work but use more CPU.
remember_group: Restore the last selected group on startup
rename_fail_dir: Folder move failed (possibly locked); database was rolled back.
rename_fail_duplicate: A group with this name already exists.
rename_fail_invalid: The name contains invalid characters or exceeds 32 characters.

reset_defaults_confirm: Reset every setting to its default value?
send_mode_file: Copy file path (recommended — paste directly in QQ/WeChat)
settings_not_ported: The settings page is not wired up yet
settings_planned: The backend interface is ready: backend.settings_store, core.settings.AppSettings, backend.supports()
settings_restart_required: This setting takes effect after restarting the program
settings_saved_immediately: Settings apply as they are changed
text_create_failed: The text sticker could not be created.
text_duplicate: That text is already in this group.
text_duplicate_msg: This text already exists in this group. Not saved.
text_group_warning:
The current group is a text group and only stores text.
Switch to an image group before importing.
text_too_long: The text is too long ({limit} characters maximum).
thread_count_hint: 0 means automatic (recommended from the CPU count).
update_bubble_msg: GIFManager v{version} is out. Click here to open the update page.
update_err_403: Access denied (GitHub API rate limit or permissions, HTTP 403). Try again later.
update_err_404: Update resource not found (repo or file missing, HTTP 404).
update_err_conn_closed: Connection lost (server closed the connection). Check your network.
update_err_conn_refused: Connection refused. Check your network and retry.
update_err_dns: Cannot reach GitHub (DNS resolution failed). Check your network.
update_err_empty: Downloaded file is empty; the installer may be gone. Try again.
update_err_invalid: Downloaded file is not a valid installer (maybe an error page). Try again.
update_err_network: Network failure (temporary network error). Check your connection.
update_err_no_release: No installer found in GitHub Releases.
update_err_parse: Failed to parse update data. Try again later.
update_err_range: The server does not support segmented downloads. Try again.
update_err_size: Downloaded file size does not match the expected size. Try again.
update_err_ssl: Secure connection failed (SSL error). Check your network environment.
update_err_timeout: Connection timed out. The network may be unstable; try again later.
update_err_unknown: Network error. Check your connection and retry.
update_found: New version v{version} ({size}) available. Click "Download Update" to start.
update_verified_checksum_only: Checksum matches only (unsigned): this proves the download is intact, not where it came from.
